summary: [[character:calvin]] surveys the B system while [[character:goku]] surveys A. Their reconnaissance finds wreckage from a destroyed [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] vessel and then locates a Brazilian construction yard building new probes; the system's surveyed resources meet [[technology:autofactory]] requirements. Calvin and Goku destroy the yard and its probes, although one vessel escapes; they claim the system, plan defensive replication with combat-class HEAVEN vessels, and decide to report to [[character:bill]] and work in pairs more often.

introducing.description: The A star component of the [[location:alpha-centauri]] system, surveyed by [[character:goku]].

introducing.name: Alpha Centauri A 1
introducing.description: A planet in [[location:alpha-centauri-a]]'s comfort zone, identified on [[character:goku]]'s first survey pass.

introducing.name: Alpha Centauri B
introducing.description: The B star component of the [[location:alpha-centauri]] system. It is more orange than [[location:sol]] and has less than half Sol's luminosity; [[character:calvin]] considers it less than ideal for a human home.

introducing.name: Alpha Centauri B 1
introducing.description: A small Mercury-like planet in an inner orbit around [[location:alpha-centauri-b]].

introducing.name: asteroid belt
introducing.description: An asteroid belt identified during [[character:calvin]]'s survey of [[location:alpha-centauri-b]]. Scouts find wreckage there from a [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] vessel, [[technology:autofactory]] equipment, and fragments from two to three vessels.

introducing.name: asteroid belt
introducing.description: A second asteroid belt in [[location:alpha-centauri-b]]'s comfort zone.

introducing.name: SURGE jammer
introducing.description: A jamming device used to interfere with an opponent's reactions during an attack.

updates.description: Small craft that investigate planets directly, filling a gap in the original mission design. In reconnaissance they activate at staggered distances on random vectors so an observer cannot trace the launching vessel, and modified [[technology:suddar]] arrays extend their survey range.

A subspace detection technology enabled by the same breakthrough as the [[technology:surge-drive]]. It can monitor distance, scan for threats and detect dense objects within a light-hour. An emitter flaw can give a much weaker ping with poor close-range sensitivity, which [[character:bill]] suspects may reach farther. It gives little fine detail at long range, and a modified array can reach three light-hours at much lower resolution.
